item.title: Solved: How to Send Multipart/Form-Data Using Python Requests
item.description:
How can you efficiently send a multipart/form-data request using Python’s requests library? Many developers encounter this challenge, especially when trying to combine file uploads with form data submission. Below, we explore various methods to tackle this task effectively, ensuring you can seamlessly send both files and data.

Top 4 Methods to Send Multipart Form-Data with Python Requests

Method 1: Basic File and Form Data Upload

The requests library allows you to upload files combined with additional form data easily. The files parameter manages uploads, providing the ability to specify filename, file object, content type, and custom headers.
